_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.layout.layout` is a semio-NATIVE artifact carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no third party can serve as its reference — see the noOracleDecision below.

oracles.rationale: 🐍️ No third-party library reads or writes s.layout.layout's .dsl.semio/.pack.semio carriers, and this repository's own five export serializers (dxf/png/svg/dwg/pdf) do not witness this artifact's shape either -- confirmed by noOracleDecisions['layout-mutation-semantics']'s carrier-side re-examination (each serializer coerces the document into an empty/erroring/unparsed result). The reference is therefore a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION rather than a third-party distribution. The implementation is ../../../🧪️tests/📐️mutate-layout-1/🐍️.py, written from this subset's own committed ../🧬️schema/🔣️.json document shape and each mutation's own committed (before, mutation, after) specification vector, and from .🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-DIRECT-LEAF-OVERHAUL/📓️taxonomy.md's create/delete/rename/change/update/reorder/edit/move/resize verb entries and 📓️derivation-rules.md's shape rules. It imports nothing from the Rust it judges and transliterates none of it -- inverse-change-data-fields restoring dataFields as an explicit null instead of omitting the key (the committed before-document genuinely omits it) is a bug a first standalone run caught and fixed before registration. All 29 kinds' mutate and inverse scenarios were executed standalone via the repository's own 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test/🖥️host/🐍️.py host against a hand-built plan -- all 58 passed (the frame-selection kinds drag-frames/rotate-frames/scale-frames added 2026-10-01, ticket 26/09/30/NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING).

candidatesConsidered.package: dxf 0.6 (rust, already a registered stdio test-oracle)
candidatesConsidered.reason: The layout->dxf export serializer coerces LayoutSnapshot through serde into a permanently empty (0-entity) dxf document regardless of content, confirmed by this repository own contract checker; reading its output witnesses nothing.

candidatesConsidered.package: png 0.18 (rust, already a registered stdio test-oracle)
candidatesConsidered.reason: The layout->png export path errors on every real document because PngSnapshot required fields carry no serde default; there is no output to read.

candidatesConsidered.package: svg/dwg export path (this repository own serializers)
candidatesConsidered.reason: Both feed the artifact own internal key=hex(json-bytes) DSL text into an SVG XML parser / SVG-to-DWG flattener and fail to parse any real document; not an independent reading.

candidatesConsidered.package: pdf export path (this repository own serializer)
candidatesConsidered.reason: Dumps the same raw hex-DSL text into one PDF text field, an alternate encoding of our own snapshot rather than a structural reading of it.
No published reader targets this repository own .dsl.semio/.pack.semio grammars; searched by name and by domain keyword, no match in pypi/crates.io/npm.

oracles.rationale: Independent RFC 6902 operations produce each structural after-document. Native semantic diffs and inverse replay consume the same language-neutral snapshots.
Lodash stable sorting independently fixes expected parent/local paint and hit-test ordering; native page resolution consumes the same portable projection fixtures and checks retained overrides.

engine.implementation: Ajv plus independent topological graph projection

oracles.rationale: Ajv independently validates scalar, identity, membership and reference projections. A Kahn topological projection witnesses acyclic text threading; fast-json-patch 3.1.1 constructs document inputs and canonical parent memberships from portable fixtures. No native mutation or validator implementation is imported.
Independent SVG rasterization and PNG decoding reproduce portable fill, stroke, alpha and rotated image probes.
Independent PNG codec encodes known RGBA proxy witnesses and decodes the SVG oracle output.
Independent TrueType parser confirms portable text witnesses have actual contours; native ttf-parser compares each transformed production glyph segment.
Independent affine matrix composition reproduces authored rotation probe coordinates and frame pivot translation.

engine.implementation: fast-json-patch with Ajv and independent Unicode token annotations

oracles.rationale: Independent RFC 6902 operations reproduce portable after-documents. Ajv graph projection and Kahn ordering verify both endpoints; token-level Unicode formatting reproduces scalar splices and UTF-8 ranges; test-only @napi-rs/canvas DOMMatrix independently witnesses finite-input transform overflow. Shared native and TypeScript semantic publication/inverse laws consume these vectors without importing oracle libraries in production.
